scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is self-contained after beta-moment formula; finite exact computations are checks only; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the origin-normalized Euclidean boundary-distance weighted Bergman family on the unit disk; continuation at t<=-1 is an RKHS kernel formula, not a positive area-weighted integral. Normalization sensitive; generic hypergeometric implicit coverage is a literature risk.
title: Disconnected positivity bands in normalized Euclidean-distance Bergman kernels
